name: chicken stir fry
description: chicken stir fry with vegetables and soy sauce.
ingredients: chicken breast (8 oz) ; bell pepper (1 cup) ; soy sauce (3 tbsp)
instructions: cook chicken until browned. ; add vegetables and stir fry. ; add soy sauce and simmer 5 minutes.

name: chocolate chip cookies
ingredients: flour (2 cups) ; sugar (1 cup) ; chocolate chips (1 cup)
instructions: mix dry ingredients. ; add wet ingredients. ; bake at 350f for 12 minutes.

name: duck and pear salad
description: crispy duct served over mixed greens with red wine poached pears.
ingredients: duck leg (2) ; thyme (2 sprigs) ; pear (1 small) ; red wine (2 cups) ; mixed greens (4 cups) ; balsamic vinegar (1/2 cups) ; olive oil (2 tbsp)
instructions: salt duck legs and cure with thyme overnight. ; slow cook duck at low temperature for 2-3 hours. ; poach pears in red wine until tender. ; reduce balsamic vinegar until thick. ; crisp duck skin in skillet before serving. ; assemble greens, sliced pear, shredded duck, and drizzle with reduction.

name: iced latte
ingredients: espresso (1 shot) ; milk (1 cup) ; ice (1 cup)
instructions: fill glass with ice. ; pour espresso over ice. ; add milk and stir.

name: garlic mashed potatoes
description: creamy mashed potatoes with roasted garlic.
ingredients: potatoes (4 large) ; butter (2 tbsp) ; garlic (3 cloves)
instructions: boil potatoes until tender. ; mash with butter and garlic.

name: beef tacos
ingredients: ground beef (1 lb) ; taco shells (8) ; lettuce (1 cup) ; shredded cheese (1/4 cup) ; sour cream (1 oz)
instructions: cook beef with seasoning. ; fill taco shells. ; add toppings and serve.

name: smoked old fashioned alchohol drink
description: bourbon cocktail with aromatic wood smoke.
ingredients: bourbon (2 oz) ; sugar cube (1) ; angostura bitters (2 dashes) ; orange peel (1 strip) ; wood chips (1 oz) ; square ice cube (1 large)
instructions: muddle sugar cube and bitters in glass. ; add bourbon and large ice cube. ; express orange peel oils over drink. ; light wood chips and capture smoke in glass dome. ; infuse drink with smoke for 30 seconds before serving.

name: vanilla cupcakes
ingredients: flour (1.5 cups) ; sugar (1 cup) ; eggs (2) ; vanilla extract (1 oz)
instructions: mix ingredients. ; pour into liners. ; bake at 350f for 18 minutes.
